verdict.summary: Round 1's major completeness defect is fixed. The analyzer now excludes tasks lacking either baseline or capability answers, records a blocking reason, and cannot recommend adoption when those omissions make the run incomplete. The added tests cover a missing answer on either arm, all baseline answers absent while token pairs remain complete, and explicit null answers; they exercise the real verdict path and pass. The remaining refusal gates and documentation are consistent with the pre-registration's complete-pair requirement.
